ratios.quote: At September 30, 2026, our leverage ratio was 1.0 to 1.0, which meets the requirement of not being above 3 to 1.

parsed.notes: The same leverage covenant disclosure appears in both the notes and MD&A; it is reported once here. The filing does not say whether the leverage ratio is gross or net, so it is classified as total leverage. Leverage-based pricing of the margin and fees is excluded.
